`cockpit/bin/ax` must be sourced. When it is executed instead (`timeout ax …`, scripts, cron), it prints "must be sourced" on **stdout** and exits 1, so a caller expecting JSON gets text. Non-interactive callers must use `cockpit/bin/ax-route`

With the R2 settings empty (tests, development), `app/services/r2.py` builds its `boto3` client with no credentials. `boto3` then falls back to its default credential chain and probes the cloud instance-metadata address `169.254.169.254`. On a cloud host, a development instance could pick up that host's role credentials. Production is safe: the configuration check requires all four R2 settings
findings.class: Pass explicit credentials or disable the metadata provider (`AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED=true`) outside production
